text:
The organ that pumps blood is the heart.

The melody haunted every character's story, a lingering reminder of the lullaby that once brought them peace. It appeared in the most unexpected places—a whistler in the street, a distant radio, the chime of a bell. Like the heart, which beats with a rhythmic persistence to sustain life, the motif of the melody tied their stories together, underscoring the shared experiences that knit the fabric of the community. Just as the heart pumps vitality through veins, the tune circulated through the town, a silent, steady pulse connecting every soul to the others, proving that even in silence, the rhythm of connection never truly stops.
